data.name: Prashant
data.gender_notes: Prashant is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit pra, 'forth', + śam, 'to be calm' — 'calm, serene'. Its root is Sanskrit pra + śam. A classical Sanskrit term for calm. Prashant is a Sanskrit name meaning “Calm; peaceful; serene”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Prashant expresses “Calm; peaceful; serene”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit pra, 'forth', + śam, 'to be calm' — 'calm, serene'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prashant total 34, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

in_english.name: Prashant
in_english.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit pra, 'forth', + śam, 'to be calm' — 'calm, serene'. Its root is Sanskrit pra + śam. A classical Sanskrit term for calm. Prashant is a Sanskrit name meaning “Calm; peaceful; serene”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.

data.cultural_impact: Prashant is used in Sanskrit naming tradition with the meaning “Calm; peaceful; serene”.
data.spiritual_significance: Any spiritual significance attached to Prashant is interpretive and is labelled as such.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “Calm; peaceful; serene” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Prashant; such symbolism is interpretive.

vedic_reference.note: Prashant is a name mentioned in various Vedic texts, particularly in the Rigveda. It is also a common name for gods and goddesses in Hindu mythology, such as Prashantaketu, the charioteer of Indra.

historical_references.reference: A classical Sanskrit term for calm.

modern_usage.modern_context: No verified modern-usage statistics are published for Prashant.

name_in_real_life.note: No verified real-life bearer is published for this name.
